title: L4.2: strict server-side HMAC enforcement (audit emission, env flags, metrics)
body:
Auto-applied from Codex Cloud, recovered by hand after the watchdog hit a label bug.

- Codex Cloud task: https://chatgpt.com/codex/tasks/task_e_6a0656335e588323ae3265d065338895
- Linked kanban: `task_20260513_nP5XNI`
- Builds on L1.2 (PR #20, merged)

What this adds on top of L1.2:
- Audit emission on every signature reject (JSONL to `/var/log/veritas/audit-signature-reject.jsonl`)
- `KANBAN_SIG_DISABLE=true` emergency-disable flag
- `KANBAN_SIG_GRACE_DAYS` env documented in `ops/HMAC-ROLLOUT.md` (phase 0 → 1 → 2 cutover)
- Diagnostics endpoint augmentation: signature counters in `GET /api/v1/auth/diagnostics`
- 4 new tests in `server/src/__tests__/middleware/`

🤖 Generated by Codex Cloud, recovered by codex-cloud-watchdog (orphan branch recovery)
